offers_products.reason: Water is delivered through regulated utility service; no separate product sales are among main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility service, plus line protection plans and municipal partnership services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Household customers receive metered water and wastewater service and buy line protection plans.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves businesses and municipalities, including public-private partnerships and fire protection service.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers pay ongoing monthly metered water and wastewater utility bills.

cyclical_demand.reason: Drinking water and wastewater service are essential utility needs that customers cannot postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent water bills, billed regularly at about a penny per gallon.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from wells, treatment plants and water mains, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households and local businesses across its service territory, not large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs wells, treatment plants, 1,515 miles of mains and storage tanks, with continuing capital investment.
